entry: 2 tranches: half now, half after the FQ4 FY26 report (expected ~2026-10-29, not yet confirmed by Apple) if the December-quarter gross-margin guide holds at or above ~47% despite 2027 memory costs; hold the second half if margin is guided below that or Duo/iPhone 18 demand disappoints
overlap: GOOGL most directly (the ~$20B/yr default-search payment is a Google cost and an Apple profit line, both exposed to the DOJ payment-ban cross-appeal); META, GOOGL and TSLA share the mega-cap growth multiple and its sensitivity to a 5%+ 10-year; AVGO, CRDO and MCHP are suppliers or share semiconductor tariff and supply-chain risk (the 2027-06-23 China legacy-chip tariff step-up).
reason: The forecasters agree closely, but their fair value (~$318) is below the ~$338 spot, the blended expected return is only ~7% against ~26% implied volatility (reward/risk ~1.07), and the view rests on how much of the rate de-rating is already priced, which is a judgment rather than a settled fact. That makes conviction low despite AAPL being one of the most liquid, long-listed and least volatile names on the list. Cap it at ~6% (~$900) as a lower-volatility ballast, staged around the late-October earnings report.
